auth.description.other: Sign in to your management workspace.

dashboard.intro.other: Manage products and your team in one workspace.

dashboard.add_product_description.other: Create product details and manage SKUs, prices, and stock.

dashboard.admins_description.other: View workspace members and their roles.

dashboard.get_started_description.other: Add size and color combinations as SKUs for each product.

admin.password_unchanged.other: Leave blank to keep the current password.

admin.form_note.other: New administrators are created as operators. Editing an account signs out its existing sessions.

product.empty.other: No products found. Add a product or change your search.

product.sku_empty.other: No SKUs have been added yet.

product.delete_confirm.other: Delete this product and all its SKUs?

sku.code_help.other: Use letters, numbers, and hyphens. The code is converted to uppercase when saved.

faq.product_sku_question.other: What is the difference between a product and an SKU?

faq.product_sku_answer.other: A product holds shared details such as its name, description, and tax rate. An SKU holds a code, price, and stock for a size and color combination.

faq.admin_question.other: What can each administrator role do?

faq.admin_answer.other: Operators can manage products and SKUs and view administrators. Super administrators can also create, edit, and delete administrators.

faq.password_question.other: What if I forget my password?

faq.password_answer.other: Ask a super administrator to reset it. Email-based password resets are not available in this version.

error.csrf.other: This form has expired. Reload the page and try again.

error.permission.other: This action requires a super administrator account.

error.internal.other: The request failed. Please try again later.

error.duplicate.other: The email address, SKU code, or size and color combination is already in use.

error.self_delete.other: You cannot delete your own account.

error.login_throttled.other: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.

error.login_invalid.other: The email address or password is incorrect.

error.product_name.other: Product name must be 1–100 characters long.

error.product_description.other: Description must be no more than 2,000 characters.

error.product_status.other: The selected product status is invalid.

error.sku_code.other: SKU code must be up to 50 characters and contain only letters, numbers, and hyphens. It must start with a letter or number.

error.sku_variant.other: Size and color must be no more than 30 characters each.

error.sku_price_stock.other: Price must be from ¥0 to ¥10,000,000, and stock must be a non-negative integer.

error.sku_integer.other: Price and stock must be integers.
